shortDescription: Adds five IKEA-themed cosmetic body genes to OMW Storageborn Xenotype; FraktaRainbow Storageborn also gain RainMaker, a one-day rain ability.
body:
## IKEA Storageborn body genes

Requires and loads after OMW Storageborn Xenotype. Defines five `GeneDef`s extending `OMW_StorageBodyBase`: Blåhaj, Frakta, and FraktaRainbow are in the Industrial Ikea category; Kallax, Billy, and Lack are in the Medieval Ikea category. Each assigns a corresponding childhood backstory, uses matching body texture paths for all body types through a BigAndSmall pawn extension, and gives its defined Storageborn gene package (including optional Alpha Genes entries). FraktaRainbow additionally forces the Gay trait.

## RainMaker ability

The FraktaRainbow body gene grants `OMW_RainMaker`. Activating it creates a map game condition that forces vanilla Rain for 60,000 ticks (one in-game day). The ability cooldown is also 60,000 ticks. The condition is registered on the caster's map.

## Categories and art

Defines Medieval Ikea and Industrial Ikea Storageborn categories with medieval and industrial world tech levels. Ships north, south, and east body textures for Blåhaj, Billy, Frakta, FraktaRainbow, Kallax, and Lack; gene icons point to the corresponding south-facing textures.
